Find Contacts screen shows " · N stops" and "Tap View on a stop, tick the people you want, then Review. Nothing is charged until you confirm."
• Progress: "Finding contacts · 0 of 4 stops · Checking FullEnrich…" → "All 4 stops checked · 4 have people".
• Per stop: "N added before · N found" + View.
• Stop people screen (company name, "Stop 3 of 4"): "Tick who to add. The price sits on each person."; people rows show "Phone · Email · 2 credits"; people already added are ticked "added before"; overlay "Searching Apollo.io for emails, phones, and company data…".
• Review (" · N selected"): drop people with the red circle. Summary: Phone or email = 2 credits each, Name and position = 1 credit, "Total 5 credits · you have 8,388". "Phones and emails take about a minute to arrive. Anyone that comes back empty is not charged." → Confirm 3 contacts · 5 credits.
• Background sheet "Getting details for 3 contacts · 0 ready · keep driving" → "All 3 contacts ready"
